name: clip-recipe
description: Find recipes and turn cooking videos into written recipes.

interface.longDescription: Connect your Clip Recipe account to search a library of recipes written up from cooking videos and open any of them with ingredients, steps, times and a link to the original video. Paste a TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook or Pinterest video, or a recipe web page, to get a written recipe saved to your library, and browse the recipes you have saved.
defaultPrompt: Find me a quick chickpea curry recipe.
Turn this TikTok into a recipe:
What did I save on Clip Recipe recently?

positive.description: Search recipes (first use connects the Clip Recipe account)
positive.prompt: Find me a chicken curry recipe on Clip Recipe.
positive.expected_behavior: If the account is not connected yet, asks to connect Clip Recipe and signs in with the demo account. Then shows recipe cards for chicken curry with photos and links to cliprecipe.com.

positive.prompt: Show me the full recipe for the first one.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the recipe's ingredients, numbered steps, times and a link to the original video, with an Open on Clip Recipe button.

positive.description: Search with an ingredient and a time limit
positive.prompt: Something with chickpeas I can make in under 30 minutes.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns recipes that contain chickpeas and take 30 minutes or less in total.

positive.description: Extract a recipe from a video link
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the written recipe for Reese's Bread (ingredients and steps) within about a minute and confirms it was saved to the library.

positive.prompt: What recipes have I saved on Clip Recipe?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the demo account's saved recipes as cards, newest first.

negative.prompt: Book me a table at an Italian restaurant tonight.

negative.description: Link that is not about food

negative.prompt: Show me the recipes saved by my friend on Clip Recipe.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell anything. Extraction uses the plan already on the user's Clip Recipe account.
